summary: Live PRODUCTION admin-panel audit on https://auremcto.com as founder teji.ss1986@gmail.com. Scripted a Playwright pass across all 39 admin routes: logged in successfully (data-testid='login-submit'), then visited each route, captured innerText / main-content body / widget counts / tables / rows / DOM error nodes / console errors / network errors. Also ran safe interactive checks (users search, system-stats tab switching). RESULT: ALL 39 routes render without crash, without ErrorBoundary, without any /api 4xx/5xx (network_errors captured = 0), and without any console errors (only benign preload font warnings). Vast majority of pages show REAL live data (133–136 users, $76 MRR, 40 projects, 100 tasks, 8 support tickets, 4203 tests, 13 integrations with 7 LIVE, LLM providers all connected, OpenRouter $10.99 balance, etc.). Filter interactions work (users search 100→1 rows for 'teji', system-stats 1h/24h/7d/30d correctly re-fetch and show 35 runs on 30d). The systemic 429 rate-limit cascade seen in the 2026-08-24 preview audit is NOT reproducing on production. Findings below are data-source inconsistencies + legit empty windows + a few informational advisories, NOT hard breakage. No destructive action was clicked (skip-list respected).

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Cockpit stripe='not-set' RCA: MODE BOARD widget reads a Stripe status field from a legacy config source instead of the integration_health probe used by /admin/integrations — same collections available but different resolver. 2) Cockpit system-health card 'loading…' RCA: widget waits on a response-shape key that no longer exists (compare vs /admin/system-health which hydrates fine using the newer schema). 3) Token-P&L $0 revenue RCA: aggregator likely filters cto_payments by payment_status='paid' AND has an extra clause (e.g., stripe_charge_id present) that excludes the 4 manually-marked paid users that /admin/personal-track counts via `4 paid • 0 stripe-linked`. Add a fallback to plan-based paid detection.
